title: ReSmith
description: Protect, lock and configure Minecraft blocks with keys, lockpicks.
body:
# 🔐 ReSmith

ReSmith is a protection and interaction mod for Minecraft multiplayer and mapmaking.

Lock blocks, assign keys, configure interactions and create protected systems using simple Shift + Right Click mechanics.

Supports:
doors, trapdoors, fence gates, chests, barrels, shulker boxes, buttons, levers, furnaces, crafting tables, hoppers, crafters and many other vanilla blocks.

---

## 🧰 Items

### Hammer
Locks and unlocks blocks.

### Wrench
Opens the configuration GUI.

### Key
A special customizable physical key item with its own hidden unique code.

### Lockpick
Attempts to force-open protected blocks.  
Always breaks after use.

---

## 🔑 Key System

Any allowed item can become a key.

The special ReSmith Key item uses its own internal code system, allowing:
- duplicate keys
- renamed keys
- colored keys
- unique key combinations

---

## ⚙️ Configuration GUI

Using the Wrench opens a GUI where you can:
- assign a key item
- configure commands
- enable Advanced Key
- enable Unbreakable

Commands can run:
- with the correct key
- without the key
- with @player replacement

This makes ReSmith useful both for survival gameplay and creative/mapmaking systems.

---

## ✨ Advanced Key

Turns the key itself into the lock/unlock tool.

Shift + Right Click:
- unlock block
- interact normally
- lock it again

---

## 🧱 Unbreakable

Makes protected blocks much harder to destroy in survival.

---

## 🗝 Lockpicks

Lockpicks can be used to force-open protected blocks.

They always break after use and only have a chance to succeed.

---

## 🛠 Configurable

Includes:
- key whitelist/blacklist
- durability matching settings
- multiplayer-safe validation
- configurable Advanced Key messages

---

Perfect for:
- multiplayer servers
- protected bases
- adventure maps
